title: Unit Circle, Six Trig Functions & 3D Helix Waves
formula: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1  |  r(θ) = (R cos θ, R sin θ, kθ)
description: Explore all six trigonometric functions (sin, cos, tan, sec, csc, cot) as geometric segments on the 2D unit circle and as orthogonal wave projections of a 3D cylindrical helix.

title: Law of Sines & Circumcircle Invariant
formula: a / sin A = b / sin B = c / sin C = 2R
description: Verify why the ratio of any triangle chord to the sine of its opposite inscribed angle is strictly constant and equal to the circumcircle diameter 2R in 2D and 3D.

title: Law of Cosines & Generalized Pythagorean Projection
description: Decompose any acute, right, or obtuse triangle via idempotent orthogonal projection and see how the 2ab cos C interaction rectangle generalizes Pythagoras' theorem.

title: Angle Sum, Difference & Rotation Matrix Composition
description: Discover how composing 2D and 3D rotation matrices R(α) and R(β) geometrically proves the compound angle identities for sin(α ± β) and cos(α ± β).
